<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-07-29

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite** (Google) — multimodal input, tool calling + web search
- 🧠 **Laguna S 2.1** (Poolside) — tool calling + reasoning
- 🧠 **LongCat 2.0** (Meituan) — tool calling + reasoning
- 🧠 **NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra** (NVIDIA) — tool calling + reasoning
- 🎨 **Recraft V4.1 Vector** (Recraft) — text/image input to image output
- 🔊 **ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue** (ElevenLabs) — text-to-audio dialogue
- 🔊 **ElevenLabs Voice Changer** (ElevenLabs) — audio-to-audio conversion
- 🔊 **ElevenLabs Voice Isolator** (ElevenLabs) — audio/video input to audio output
- 🔊 **Lyria 3 Clip** (Google) — text-to-audio music generation
- 🔊 **CSM 1B** (Sesame) — text-to-speech
- 20 community text models and 26 community image models also added

### 🗑️ Removed
- 25 text models removed, including `gemini-flash-lite-3.1` and `polly`

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🧠 Text: `gemini` (~15%) · `gemini-search-large` (~15%) · `MarcosFRG/gemma-4-31b` (~30%) · `MarcosFRG/deepseek-v4-flash` (~55%) · `MarcosFRG/minimax-m3` (~20%)

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🧠 Text: `gemini-search-fast` (~65%) · `MarcosFRG/gemini-2.5-flash-lite` (~20%) · `MarcosFRG/gemini-3-flash-preview` (~20%) · `MarcosFRG/gemini-3.1-flash-lite` (~20%) · `MarcosFRG/glm-5.2` (~340%) · `CloudCompile/afforda-claude-haiku-4.5` (~5%) · `vendouple/claude-opus-4-8` (~100%)

### ✨ Capability updates
- `gemini-3-flash`, `gemini`, `gemini-fast`, `gemini-search`, `gemini-search-fast`, `gemini-search-large` — code execution removed
- `claude-large` — renamed to Claude Opus 5

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
